title: Weekly Market Review
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Risk-off week; defensives and precious metals bid, small caps and cyclicals sold.
Money left the broad tape and crowded into healthcare and silver; SPY fell again even as QQQ and semis firmed, so the average stock did the damage. Breadth confirmed it: 163 advancers against 337 decliners, only 28% of S&P names above their 50-day.

INDICES — QQQ +0.92%, SPY -0.34%, IWM -1.66%, DIA -1.88%. Large beat small by 2.58pp (large +0.92% vs small -1.66%). VIX closed at 14.8, below its 15.7 20-day average, so the tape sold without hedging demand. Most notable cross-asset move: SLV +3.11% WTD, silver leading everything. IWM, DIA, IJH and IJR are all below their 200-day lines.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLV +1.83%, XLK +1.03%, XLP -0.70%, XLE -1.27%, XLI -1.52%, XLC -1.59%, XLY -1.71%, XLB -1.88%, XLRE -2.05%, XLF -2.43%, XLU -3.04%. Industries: CIBR +5.79% and WGMI +5.18% led; OIH -5.22% and UTES -4.51% lagged. Flows went into XLF +$1.15B (96th pct) and XLY +$375M while XLK bled -$347M and XLP -$327M — the exact inverse of price. Rotation-state: defensive risk-off.

DRIVERS — Utilities, REITs and financials — the rate-sensitive cohort — were the worst three sectors, while XLV and XLK gained and silver jumped. Semis were split, not uniform: AMAT +6.51% and LRCX +6.98% rallied on the week's final session while QCOM -5.82% unwound a prior month's run, so SOXX's +1.14% WTD masks internal churn. Long-end bonds sold, TLT -0.65% Friday, and oil slipped, USO -0.96%. Vol stayed low anyway — VVIX 87.4 under its 89.2 average — so positioning, not fear, drove the selling.

WHAT'S NEXT — With 73 new 60-day lows against 6 highs and only 49% of names above their 200-day, the index masks a broad internal breakdown, so watch whether IWM — 98th-percentile inflows at +$2.9B — finally catches a bid. Watch the October 28 FOMC, where Polymarket prices 54% odds of a hike versus 44% hold; rate-sensitive utilities and REITs sit at the inflection. SPY maxpain 760 against GEX flip 768 keeps the tape pinned near spot absent a breadth reversal.
